title: External SEO Ranking Snapshot
description: Output contract for the external-seo ranking fetch node. A content-addressed ranking snapshot envelope produced by the External node. Carries one rank entry per requested keyword plus fetch provenance so downstream stages (analytics compute, scenario follow-up) can reason about freshness deterministically.

fetchedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp the snapshot was produced.

searchEngine.description: Search engine the snapshot was fetched from.

isTrackedDomain.description: True when the result URL host matches the request trackedDomain.
